evidence_tier: source-authenticated feasibility audit; no ablation executed and no performance effect established
decision: no-go for a preregistered CAM artifact ablation with currently verified public data; conditional go only after authorized release of project-linked logs, cause labels, and artifacts

objective_interpretation.target_endpoint: project-disjoint multiclass cause-classification accuracy comparing log-only CAM with an added-artifact arm at matched training budget
objective_interpretation.secondary_endpoint: binary product-fault recall/FaultCaught, reported separately and not used as a substitute for multiclass cause accuracy
objective_interpretation.unit_and_split: alarm/test-log instances grouped by industrial project; train, validation, and test projects must be disjoint, with no repeated alarm, near-duplicate log, artifact, or temporal leakage across groups
objective_interpretation.class_skew: must report per-class support, macro-F1, balanced accuracy, multiclass accuracy, one-vs-rest AUPRC/AUROC where defined, calibration, and confusion matrices; majority-class accuracy is a baseline, not evidence of cause-model quality

sources_and_data.title: What Causes My Test Alarm? Automatic Cause Analysis for Test Alarms in System and Integration Testing

inspected_facts.population: two Huawei industrial testing projects, DS1 and DS2
inspected_facts.size_and_time: 14,640 total test logs; DS1 7,663 over 40 testing days and DS2 6,977 over 22 days; raw dataset sizes reported as 4.72 GB and 6.06 GB
inspected_facts.schema_level: test-log text with manually labeled failure cause; the paper describes logs, timestamps/test steps, function points, and cause labels, but does not release the raw industrial records
inspected_facts.classes: DS1 has seven cause classes and DS2 six; DS1 product-code defects are 58.19%, while test-script defects are 11.64% and environmental issues 0.28%; DS2 product-code defects are 28.14%, test-script defects 46.71%, and environmental issues 2.41%
inspected_facts.reported_endpoint: CAM multiclass accuracy 58.3% on DS1 and 65.8% on DS2; these are not project-disjoint transfer estimates
inspected_facts.artifact_availability: the paper uses test logs and labels; no public release of the paired software artifacts needed for an added-artifact arm was located in this audit
inspected_facts.access_status: industrial data are not publicly downloadable from the inspected paper/source pages; authorization and a data-use agreement would be required

sources_and_data.title: Mining Historical Test Logs to Predict Bugs and Localize Faults in the Test Logs

inspected_facts.population: Ericsson integration-test failure logs, independent of the Huawei CAM team/data
inspected_facts.reported_endpoint: plain CAM at K=15 catches 50.00% of product faults (FaultCaught); the paper also reports variants using Exclusive KNN and line-flagging metrics
inspected_facts.task_change: the analysis is binary product-fault versus non-product/environmental failure plus fault-line localization, not multiclass cause classification
inspected_facts.skew_and_scope: the authors attribute plain CAM's poor transfer to a high proportion of environmental failures and skewed KNN voting
inspected_facts.artifact_availability: the inspected paper reports Ericsson logs and derived processing, but does not release the industrial logs, labels, or a paired software-artifact corpus
inspected_facts.population_reconciliation: the 50% product-fault result is not numerically comparable to the 2017 58.3%/65.8% multiclass accuracies and is not an artifact-on/off result

sources_and_data.title: Alarm logs of industrial packaging machines

inspected_facts.schema: raw CSV rows contain timestamp, alarm code, and machine serial
inspected_facts.coverage: 20 machines in different plants, 2019-02-21 through 2020-06-17, 154 alarm codes; the repository reports highly unbalanced distributions
inspected_facts.available_labels: alarm-code/sequence targets for forecasting and multi-label alarm prediction; no human multiclass cause label corresponding to CAM C1-C7 was found
inspected_facts.project_disjointness: machine serials support a possible machine-grouped split, but plant/project identity, independent cause adjudication, and software-project artifacts are not provided in the inspected schema/readme
inspected_facts.artifact_arm: no source code, test scripts, configuration files, or other paired software artifacts are included

sources_and_data.evidence_role: public schema/license inspection; insufficient endpoint match

sources_and_data.title: causRCA: Real-World Dataset for Causal Discovery and Root Cause Analysis in Machinery

inspected_facts.schema: time-series recordings from CNC control, normal real-operation data, digital-twin fault scenarios, labels for underlying simulated cause and diagnosis, and an expert causal graph
inspected_facts.coverage: coolant, hydraulics, and probe experiment groups with multiple runs per scenario
inspected_facts.project_disjointness: scenario/run grouping may support grouped evaluation, but this is machinery fault diagnosis rather than industrial software test-alarm data and does not expose software projects or paired software artifacts
inspected_facts.artifact_arm: no software source, test scripts, or configuration artifacts matching the CAM added-artifact intervention are provided

sources_and_data.evidence_role: public labeled-fault alternative; insufficient modality and population match

sources_and_data.title: 3W: Anomaly Detection Dataset
sources_and_data.license: dataset CC BY 4.0; toolkit Apache-2.0 as described on the inspected page

inspected_facts.schema: multivariate oil-well time series with sample and fault-type labels
inspected_facts.endpoint_match: supports fault diagnosis/classification, but not CAM-style software test logs, human cause classes C1-C7, or paired software artifacts
inspected_facts.split_match: well/event grouping could be investigated, but project-disjoint software transfer is not established by the inspected description

sources_and_data.evidence_role: public labeled-fault alternative; insufficient modality and population match

actions_completed: Read project state, queue, status, Paper 3 and Paper 4 methodology, and the prior CAM trajectory audit.
Inspected the primary 2017 CAM source metadata and dataset table claims.
Inspected the 2019 independent replication's endpoint, class-skew discussion, and reported CAM result.
Inspected public dataset landing pages/readmes, licenses, schemas, labels, grouping fields, and artifact availability for the packaging-machine alarm, causRCA, and 3W datasets.
Applied an endpoint gate: do not pool binary product-fault recall with multiclass cause accuracy or treat alarm-code/fault labels as CAM cause labels.
method.not_run: No model fitting, data download into the repository, label conversion, or ablation was run because no verified dataset satisfied the required labels plus paired artifacts plus project-disjoint grouping conditions.

observed_result_or_blocker.result: No currently verified public dataset supports the full comparison. The closest public dataset has 20 machine serial groups and CC BY 4.0 data but only alarm-code sequence labels; the other public labeled-fault datasets are machinery/process time series without software artifacts. The original Huawei and Ericsson industrial records are not publicly released in the inspected sources.
blockers: No public paired corpus containing log-only inputs, additional software artifacts, and independently adjudicated multiclass cause labels.
No verified public project identifier/split unit for the closest alarm dataset; machine serial is not assumed to equal independent software project.
No authorized data-use agreement or industrial data delivery was available in this session.
2019 FaultCaught is a binary product-fault recall endpoint and cannot validate the target multiclass cause-accuracy claim.
observed_result_or_blocker.go_no_go: NO-GO now; CONDITIONAL GO after authorized data access and schema audit

next_falsifiable_action.action: Request a de-identified, access-controlled release from an industrial partner containing at least three independent projects (or an explicitly documented project-equivalent grouping), raw test logs, artifact snapshots available at prediction time, single or adjudicated cause labels, timestamps, project IDs, and label provenance. Freeze an artifact manifest and preregistration before modeling.

arms: log-plus-artifact CAM with artifacts restricted to information available at alarm time
minimum_protocol.split: leave-one-project-out or train/validation/test project holdout; no within-project random split as the primary result
metrics: binary product-fault recall as a separately labeled secondary endpoint
controls: matched training examples and tuning budget
minimum_protocol.falsification_gate: abstain from a positive artifact claim if the artifact arm does not improve predeclared macro-F1 and balanced accuracy on held-out projects, or if label/schema alignment fails; report nulls and negative class-specific effects

next_falsifiable_action.estimated_cost: planning estimate only: 1-2 person-weeks for data-use approval, de-identification/schema audit, project-group integrity checks, and preregistration; approximately 1-3 additional CPU-days for a small classical CAM ablation once data are delivered. These costs were not incurred or externally confirmed in this audit.

uncertainty: Public dataset descriptions were inspected, but absence of a field on a landing page/readme is not proof that an undisclosed authorized supplement cannot exist.
The exact first-public date and full access terms for the 2019 author draft are not independently reconstructed here; this does not affect the endpoint mismatch.
Machine, well, or scenario grouping in public alternatives may be useful for other fault-diagnosis studies but has not been shown to represent independent software projects.
The proposed minimum project count and cost are feasibility assumptions for a small preregistered test, not observed power or validated effect-size claims.
No causal benefit of adding artifacts, no multiclass transfer performance, and no Paper 3 forecast skill are established.
negative_results_preserved: No public dataset inspected supplied the complete required endpoint and artifact pairing.
The 2019 50% product-fault result remains an independent binary transfer observation only.
